label: Brenton Septuagint Translation
textualBasis: Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton's English translation of the Greek Septuagint. Imported from the eBible.org eng-Brenton USFM edition with native LXX chapter/verse numbering and lettered LXX verses preserved. The eBible EZR file repeats Nehemiah as chapters 11–23 while also supplying a standalone NEH file; Lege Lux retains Ezra 1–10 and the standalone Nehemiah copy to avoid duplicating the same text in the book picker.
